title: Apple
visualIntent: A launch-first consumer hardware system built on obsessive restraint, oversized product imagery, near-silent chrome, and premium confidence.

compositionRecipes.label: Apple default
compositionRecipes.whenToUse: Use this as the default build recipe whenever Apple is the locked primary reference.
compositionRecipes.heroStructure: Build a keynote-style hero anchored by one dominant product object, quiet negative space, and a compact copy block that frames the object rather than competing with it.
sectionOrder: Hero keynote frame with one product image and one dominant statement.
Focused product detail bands or capability callouts with careful hierarchy.
Cinematic product gallery or finish/color story section.
Quiet purchase, compare, or learn-more close instead of a noisy CTA wall.
compositionRecipes.headlineImageRelationship: Keep the headline framing the product from above, beside, or just over the object with disciplined restraint; only use overlap when it strengthens the product keynote feel.
layeringRules: Keep layering sparse and exact so the product remains dominant and the composition stays severe.
Use one dominant foreground relationship and one subordinate supporting layer; do not stack decorative layers without purpose.
Every overlap, crop, or z-index shift should strengthen the selected reference rather than adding generic drama.
compositionRecipes.typeScaleRelationship: Keep scale controlled and deliberate so one product frame or one precise headline leads the page.
compositionRecipes.paletteDistribution: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.
compositionRecipes.imageFraming: Imagery should center the product object and make the hardware feel tangible, premium, and hero-worthy.
compositionRecipes.asymmetry: Keep asymmetry restrained and category-correct rather than theatrical for its own sake.
compositionRecipes.ctaPosture: Keep CTAs sparse, exact, and product-native.

typeSystemBehavior: Use typography to reinforce the product category and reference family rather than generic startup-safe hierarchy.
Keep the type system restrained, exact, and highly disciplined.
Keep supporting typography subordinate to the primary visual system instead of flattening everything into one neutral sans rhythm.
paletteBehavior: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.
Use color to support hierarchy and domain clarity before decoration.
Keep palette choices visibly native to the selected reference family.

antiPatterns: Do not inject busy feature-card grids just to make the page feel complete.
Do not drift into developer-platform darkness, generic startup gradients, or editorial chaos.
Do not let runtime overrides overpower the near-silent Apple restraint.
allowedVariation: Content, brand naming, and product specifics may change freely as long as the composition DNA remains recognizably native to the selected reference family.
You may vary product details and supporting section order, but not the core restraint or system logic of the reference.
Do not use variety as an excuse to fall back to generic AI-generated landing-page patterns.

exemplarCues.label: Keynote object framing
cues: One hero object dominates the viewport.
Headline and copy frame the object with severe restraint.
Supporting sections stay quieter than the hero.
